save_success: "{{name}}" saved. Click "Re-apply" below to push it to assigned domains.

defaults.title: Defaults
defaults.desc: Initial values applied when a new domain is created under this plan.
defaults.php_version_hint: New domains under this plan will be set up with this PHP version.

resource_limits.title: Resource Limits
resource_limits.desc: Enforced at the OS level via systemd cgroup + xfs_quota + MariaDB GRANT. After saving, trigger "Re-apply" for assigned domains.
resource_limits.ram_hint: Hard MemoryMax; MemoryHigh automatically set to 90%
resource_limits.pm_max_children_hint: 0 = Automatic (max(4, RAM/64)). Consistent with the RAM cap in per-tenant FPM.
resource_limits.io_section_label: Disk I/O (absolute throttle — distinct from IOWeight; cgroup v2)
resource_limits.io_read_iops_hint: Maximum read operations per second. 0 = unlimited
resource_limits.io_write_iops_hint: Maximum write operations per second. 0 = unlimited
resource_limits.db_section_label: Database (MySQL Governor — native MariaDB; connection limit is "MySQL Connections" above)
resource_limits.db_max_query_seconds_hint: Queries exceeding this duration are KILLED (watchdog). 0 = no kill

numeric_limits.title: Numeric Limits
numeric_limits.desc: Number of objects that can be created in the account bound to this plan. 0 = unlimited.

web_server.title: Web Server (nginx)
web_server.desc: New domains under this plan will be set up with these nginx settings. Extra directives are validated with "nginx -t" on save.
web_server.fastcgi_cache_hint: Caches dynamic PHP output on the nginx side (for high-traffic sites)
web_server.upload_size_hint: nginx client_max_body_size — upper bound for file uploads
web_server.extra_directives_hint: Inserted into the server{} block; validated on save.
web_server.extra_directives_note: ⓘ When you click Save, the directives are tested with nginx -t in a temporary server block. If invalid, the plan is not saved and the nginx error output is shown above.

waf.title: Web Application Firewall (WAF) Default
waf.desc: ModSecurity v3 + OWASP Core Rule Set. Domains under this plan (without their own WAF override) inherit these values. If "Inherit from Plan" is selected at the domain level, the setting here applies.
waf.waf_default_hint: Should new domains under this plan have WAF enabled? (overridable per domain).
waf.mode_hint: Block = 403s bad requests (SecRuleEngine On). Detect = only writes to audit log (DetectionOnly).
waf.paranoia_hint: CRS paranoia 1–4. Higher = stricter protection + more false positives.
waf.note: ⓘ After changes, the vhosts of domains bound to this plan are automatically re-rendered in the background (nginx -t protected, zero downtime). If the module isn't installed on the server, the setting is stored and enabled with sanalcp-waf-setup.

assigned_domains.title: Assigned Domains ({{count}})
assigned_domains.desc: After updating the plan, use "Re-apply" to refresh the relevant domain's cgroup + quota + MySQL limits.
assigned_domains.empty: No domains are assigned to this plan yet.
